name: the-human-economy
why: Opens on "You print papers from nothing"; the whole loop, its death toll and the alternative in under a minute, ending on "too advanced for you".

name: 604-to-1
why: "You only do things when given small pieces of paper with presidents on them", then what papers make humans do, then the 604 bar.

name: two-mistakes
why: Opens on "Your regulatory system can make two mistakes"; pays off with the 3,389 : 1 scale crashing and "main product is dead patients".

name: 121-apocalypses
why: "This is going to sound crazy", the 1% treaty in one breath, ending on "121 civilizational collapses instead of 122. This should be more than sufficient."

name: grandmas-war-bond
why: "Remember when your grandparents funded World War Two by buying bonds?" and the two lists side by side, ending on "Also no Nazis (as a bonus)."

name: democracy-dog
why: "There's literally no voting your way out of this"; the same dog, reelected for chasing a tail of cured diseases.

name: you-bought-the-other-thing
why: Opens on $2.72 trillion a year spent on stuff designed to make humans stop being alive; ends on "You bought the other thing."

name: soviet-plan
why: The shortest one: 25% of GDP by 2033, and "the Soviet Union's terrible plan beat your no plan, and the Soviet Union lost."

name: donut-doctor
why: A doctor picking treatments by good donuts, grape soda and the meadow ad, ending on "What happens." Needs no context.

name: briber-conversion-therapy
why: Opens on "Professional Briber Conversion Therapy"; lands on "It is arithmetic."

name: two-futures
why: "Future A: You Ignore This Manual", year by year, until the cockroaches find the manual, very confused.

name: humanity-has-no-choice
why: "The twist: you might do this anyway", ending on "This is why aliens don't visit" and the final stamp.

name: tell-the-orderly
why: A padded room and "here's what you tell the orderly"; the war supply chain switched off, ending on "Getting one billionaire to read a P.D.F. is."
